items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I had another band on 52nd Street with Dexter Gordon playing tenor sax, and Jimmy Jones playing piano.

ctx.x: two of them with Billy Eckstine's big band. But I can't -- I couldn't tell you the year. I really couldn't tell you.
And I had another band on 52nd Street with Dexter Gordon playing tenor sax, and Jimmy Jones playing piano. Now, Jimmy could probably tell you the year that they were with me on that gig, see.

items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yeah, we had a nice little outfit on 52nd Street, at the Three Deuces.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, we had a nice little outfit on 52nd Street, at the Three Deuces.
